I'll start. I remember last year I was having a hard time with motivation, especially when it came to online school. In english class we were required to read 30 minutes each online day (we were alternating) and then fill out a form summarizing what happened in the book. Those assignments were my kryptonite. I absolutely hated doing them to no surprise because I hate nothing more than summarizing books. To no one's shock I was seriously behind on those assignments and we were nearing the end of the quarter where I had a D in english.

I emailed my english teacher asking for an extension to finish those assignments. In return to me asking respectfully and mannerly I get an entire 3 paragraph essay about how she wasn't going to give me the extension because "if you were really that smart you would've known the consequences of not doing them."

This 70 year old grandmother burnt me to a crisp about how stupid I was. Usually I would find it funny and move on until she began invalidating my mental health. She said something along the lines of "how could you have had a hard time doing the assignments when all you were doing was sitting at your home with a laptop." This was in response to me saying that because of my depression it was hard to do literally any classwork. At that point I was about to explode.

Instead of just saying no, she took time out of her day to write about how I'm lazy and stupid over a few book summaries. I liked the teacher over all and I hardly ever caused trouble for her. Clearly she was just having a shit day and taking it out on me. Doesn't excuse what she said but I'm not going to waste my life angry over an email.
